idea-plugin.name: Gosu Mutation Testing
idea-plugin.description:
Mutation testing for Gosu classes, from the IDE.
Right-click a .gs file and choose Run Mutation Testing: the class and its tests are copied into a separate trial project, mutated one change at a time and tested. The results show in the Gosu Mutation tool window and as markers in the editor; an HTML report is written too. Original files are never modified. Tests can be files or whole folders, chosen once per class with Run Mutation Testing with Chosen Tests....
When the class depends on types that are not available, Build AI Stub Request prepares a request for an AI assistant (for example GitHub Copilot Chat in agent mode) to create minimal stand-in types, and Build AI Test Request asks it for tests that detect the mutants that survived. Mutants that no test can detect can be marked as equivalent, so they are left out of the score.
